Sam Ortiz: quick postmortem follow-up — we captured the remediation list but didn't assign owners for runbook/playbook edits or recurrence tracking. can we split ownership?
Nora Blake: I can take the triage playbook (low-latency path). target: next Mon EOD.
Ethan Park: I'll own the escalation flow and oncall paging matrix. aiming for Wed.
Ravi Desai: I will add recurrence tagging automation in the incident tracker and a short playbook section for recurring patterns. Tue for initial draft.
Sam Ortiz: awesome. can we also decide what commands go into the runbook (safe checks + idempotent ops)?
Nora Blake: yes. i'll add safe-checks and an explicit rollback snippet. will keep commands copy-paste ready.
Nora Blake: ```
# check p95 before acting
rwinfctl metrics get --model=chat-main --window=5m | jq '.p95'
# if sustained above threshold for 3 samples, dry-run route change
rwinfctl router set-route --route=chat-main --model=chat-fallback --weight=100 --dry-run
# confirm and apply (idempotent)
rwinfctl router set-route --route=chat-main --model=chat-fallback --weight=100
```
Ethan Park: proposal for paging: extend the transient spike window from 5m -> 8m for p95 alerts, add a step: "verify traffic spike not from batch jobs" before paging.
Ravi Desai: for recurrence tagging I'll add label recurrence:yes and a field recurrence_count. also will create a saved filter for "recent repeats".
incident-bot: created TKT-7895 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-7895) "Runbook & Playbook edits from 1912507880 incident" assigned to Nora, Ethan, Ravi. Due dates: Nora: 1912627200, Ethan: 1912713600, Ravi: 1912640800.
sre-rotations: noted. i'll roll the threshold change to staging and add a grafana panel for "recurring incidents count". will link in playbook.
Sam Ortiz: please paste the repo/doc paths below so I can track diffs and add them to the postmortem action tracker. also let's include a tiny eval check (MTTI before vs after) in the PR description.
Nora Blake: triage playbook path: docs/runbooks/triage/low-latency-playbook.md
Ethan Park: escalation matrix + diagram: docs/runbooks/escalation/oncall-paging-matrix.md (diagram in drawio linked in PR)
Ravi Desai: recurrence playbook and automation: docs/playbooks/recurrence/recurrence-automation.md
incident-bot: updated TKT-7895 with file links and set reminders 3 days before due dates.
Nora Blake: i'll open a draft PR today and ping for reviews. PR will include a short test plan and verification steps.
Ethan Park: i'll attach the paging diagram and a step-by-step escalation checklist. will call out which teams to page at each severity.
Ravi Desai: scheduling a biweekly "recurrence review" meeting and a tiny template for notes. will invite SRE + Prod.
Sam Ortiz: perfect. once PRs are merged i'll mark the postmortem actions closed. thanks everyone. :clap:
